tool_input.command: bash -n rotate.sh && bash -n verify.sh && bash -n lib/common.sh && echo "syntax ok" && /bin/bash --version | head -1

t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/dest"
printf 'a\n' > "$t/dest/space name-20260101-000000.tar.gz"
(cd "$t/dest" && shasum -a 256 "space name-20260101-000000.tar.gz" > "space name-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256")
printf 'onlydigest\n' > "$t/dest/broken.tar.gz.sha256"
echo "--- /bin/bash 3.2, space name + malformed sidecar ---"
VERBOSE=0 /bin/bash verify.sh --dest "$t/dest"; rc=$?; echo "rc=$rc (expect 2, BAD only for broken)"
echo "--- --name filter ---"
out=$(bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name space); echo "rc=$? out=$out"
echo "--- rotate: --keep=N, dry-run, --dest, unknown flag ---"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest="$t/dest" --name "space name" --keep=1 --dry-run; echo "rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh -h | head -1
bash rotate.sh --bogus 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
bash verify.sh --dest 2>&1 | tail -1
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Exercise flags, sidecar edge cases, and bash 3.2 on rotate/verify
